other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Gypsum calcination in kiln/oven 5 described explicitly as a continuous ('online') thermal process, a continuous-flow signal in non-metallic mineral processing
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: The main function of oven 5 is the thermal transformation using a gaseous fuel; here, the calcination of natural gypsum is carried out, which is considered important as it is an online process.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Plant runs three shifts covering a full 24-hour cycle, indicating round-the-clock operation of the mineral-processing facility
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The three shifts correspond to the following time slot; Shift 1:
From 6:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.; Shift 2: From 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.;
and Shift 3: From 10:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. of the same day and
12:00 a.m. to 5:00 a.m. of the following day.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Continuous feeding logic on the mill described (feeder cycles on/off by classifier pressure; feeding must be constant), and oven left on continuously overnight
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: the feeding must be constant and guarantee maximum use

one_line: The paper applies an ISO 50002 energy audit to a Colombian SME in the non-metallic mineral sector (gypsum grinding and calcination for plaster, stucco and mortars), which is not one of the registered Corpus B sectors, though it involves a continuously operated calcination kiln.
